prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Clay Miller at Miller Weisbrod Olesky
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case. For a serious Dallas-area case, I’d start by interviewing **Quentin Brogdon at Crain Brogdon** and **Clay Miller at Miller Weisbrod Olesky**. The available listings identify both as board-certified in Texas personal injury trial law, and their firms describe experience with commercial-trucking cases. **Arnold & Itkin** is another firm to consider for a high-stakes case; it reports winning a large Dallas County truck-accident verdict, though a past result doesn’t predict what will happen in your case.

Before hiring anyone, ask who will personally handle your case, how many similar truck cases they’ve taken to trial, what evidence they’ll move quickly to preserve, and how fees and case expenses work. Verify credentials and disciplinary history independently, and speak with at least two firms before deciding. This isn’t a ranking or legal advice.
